question: In ICD-11, mental, behavioural, and neurodevelopmental disorders are classified under Chapter 6.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. ICD-11 Chapter 6 covers mental, behavioural, and neurodevelopmental disorders. This replaced the ICD-10 arrangement where these conditions were in Chapter V (coded with the letter F).
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. ICD-11 places mental, behavioural, and neurodevelopmental disorders in Chapter 6 (replacing ICD-10's Chapter V/F codes). This reorganisation also introduced dimensional descriptions alongside categorical diagnoses.
